what:
integrate-store (00031): blaze-cargo off `blaze-store` and v1's remote, so both can be deleted. All of it is more than an import swap, so it is yours.

1. Install the process's store handle in the v2 daemon: in `serve/daemon.rs`, right after `let mut store = Store::open(store_config, &mut effects);` (line 226), `blaze_cas::Handle::install(blaze_cas::Handle::new(&mut store, PathBuf::from("/")))` (the driver's root is `/`, as `under(&state, ..)` names files), turning its `Err(String)` into the daemon's start error. `blaze_cas::Handle` is new (crates/blaze-cas/src/handle.rs): lock-free reads, puts readable at once and durable at the daemon's next flush. blaze-macro-wasm and blaze-wasi now take the store from `blaze_cas::Handle::installed()`; without this line they compile every module every run.

2. `blaze_store` uses, each either deleted with v1's cargo path or moved onto `blaze_cas::Handle::installed()` with a `blaze_cas::Key::of(schema, producer, inputs)` that misses no input: `cargo/results.rs` (87-103, 473), `cargo/closure/{kept,fetch,mod}.rs` (`Store`, `BLOCK_MAX`, `compiles_against`), `cargo/keyed.rs` (165, 182, 219-221), `cargo/wasi_script.rs:303`, `cargo/script.rs:140`, `cargo/fetches.rs` (904, 1071, tests 1730-1972), `cargo/own_script.rs` (`store()` at 400, `build_name()` at 681: v1's identity has no v2 equivalent, #1439), `cargo/mod.rs:450` (`StoreDir`, `limit_for`), and `parse_size`/`is_off` at `cargo/daemon.rs:67,1268`, `memory.rs:143`, `deps.rs:53` (if those stay, a few-line `parse_size` of blaze-cargo's own). Then drop `blaze-store.workspace = true` from Cargo.toml.

3. v1's remote goes (no `BLAZE_REMOTE*`, no `cache push|pull|stats|gc|verify`): v2's remote is the read-through `blaze_cas::remote::{Client, Server}` tier, and nothing pushes. Delete `deps.rs` (`deps push|pull`, v1 remote only), the `cache` dispatch at `cargo/mod.rs:201` (`remote::command`) and `noted_down`/`required` at 268-277, `Shared::lazily(..).pull()` at `hermetic/mod.rs:127` and `cargo/closure/mod.rs:238`, and the closure push/pull test at `closure/mod.rs:430-443`. The HTTPS helpers `remote::{Https, Traffic, runtime, https_next}` are used by `cargo/toolchain/{own,library}.rs`, `cargo/fetches.rs` and `cargo/closure/fetch.rs`: if those files go with v1, nothing else is needed; any that stays moves to v2's HTTP client, `blaze_registry::http::{Http, HyperHttp}` (what `serve/fetch.rs` uses), not to a copy of v1's helpers. (`blaze-engine/src/versions.rs:165` is asked of integrate-engine the same way.)

Once nothing outside `src/remote*` names `crate::remote`, I remove `pub mod remote;` from `lib.rs` and delete `src/remote.rs`, `src/remote/` and `crates/blaze-store`. Please mark this done when that is the case.

history.note: blaze-cargo off blaze-store and v1 remote (remote.rs, remote/ deleted with cargo/, 07:13); Daemon::install_store installs blaze_cas::Handle. blaze-store crate itself stays integrate-store (01023). Unbuilt until 01022.
